decisions.briefing: Markets pulled back today with NASDAQ down 1.1% and S&P 500 down 0.6%, putting conditions in risk-off territory. No new candidates were screened, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash on the sidelines rather than forcing a buy.

market_education.summary_en: Tech and broad-market stocks slipped today as investors grew cautious, pulling NASDAQ down 1.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.6%. The pullback reflects a broader risk-off shift rather than any single company-specific event in our portfolio. With momentum signals weak across the board, no new stocks cleared the screening bar today.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日科技股及大盤股普遍走弱，投資者轉趨審慎，納斯達克指數下跌1.1%，標普500指數下跌0.6%。此次回調反映整體市場風險偏好轉弱，並非個股特定事件所致。由於市場動能訊號普遍疲弱，今日並無新股票通過篩選門檻。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: 'Risk-off' describes a market mood where investors pull back from riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward safety, often triggered by uncertainty about the economy or interest rates. On days like this, it's usually smarter to hold existing positions and wait rather than chase new trades, since momentum and volume signals tend to be unreliable.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「risk-off」（風險規避）是指投資者在面對經濟或利率不確定性時，傾向減少持有風險較高的資產（如成長股），轉向較安全的資產。在這種市況下，通常較明智的做法是持有現有倉位並觀望，而非追逐新交易，因為動能與成交量訊號在此時往往不可靠。
